about_the_game:
‘Every wreck has a soul. All you have to do is find it.’

Build homes from metal and memories in House Builder – Mechitecture Edition DLC! 🚂✈️⛵ Restore trains, planes, and boats, turning scrap into stunning living spaces. Rust meets creativity in this upcycling adventure! ♻️🏡

Embark on an extraordinary journey where rusty wrecks and forgotten structures are given a new purpose. Restore an old train car, bring back the shine of a derelict plane, and give new life to an abandoned boat. Each of these items will become part of a unique home, created from history, passion and your hands. Because sometimes what's old can become the foundation of something beautiful.

A fishing boat - a fishing corner 🛥️

On the shore of a quiet lake rests the former wreck of a fishing boat - today the heart of a unique home. Its hull becomes a cosy living room overlooking the water. The whole thing blends seamlessly with the classic bungalow, creating a place full of nostalgia, nature and warmth - the wood smells of salt, every detail tells the story of past voyages. The perfect haven for those who want to stop for just a moment.

Train carriage - home on the tracks of time 🚋

An old train carriage, once gliding across continents, now gains new life as part of a unique home. The spacious interior of the train carriage is transformed into a stylish living area, while original details add an industrial charm. For those who love to travel, even in their own backyard.

Aeroplane fuselage - home from the skies 🛬

A rusty aircraft converted into a modern living space? Why not! The fuselage becomes a place to work or relax, while the wings serve as a terrace overlooking the garden. It's a design full of lightness, boldness and aeronautical character - perfect for those who dream of flying, even from the ground
